ROSY PRADHAN Trade Support & Settlement Operations Professional | FX • Fixed Income • Derivatives • Fund Reconciliation Pune, India | +91 7039332640 | rozylovely000@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/rosy-pradhan-dec193

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Trade support and settlement operations professional with 8+ years managing end-to-end trade lifecycle across FX, Money Markets, Fixed Income, Equities, OTC Derivatives, and ETFs for global banks and asset servicers (BNY Mellon, ANZ, Hexaware, WNS). Deep hands-on expertise across Bloomberg, Murex, Finastra, TLM, CLS, and FXALL, with a consistent record of resolving high-stakes settlement exceptions, strengthening custodian and cash/position reconciliation controls, and acting as the trusted link between front office, clients, and operations. Skilled in corporate actions processing, client/portfolio onboarding, MIS and regulatory reporting (SWIFT MT3xx/MT1xx/MT2xx), and cross-functional stakeholder management. Builds clean, audit-ready processes that scale across teams and reduce operational risk.

CORE SKILLS

Trade Confirmation & Settlement (FX, MM, Fixed Income) | Cash & Position Reconciliation | Custodian & Prime Broker Reconciliation | Cross-Asset Trade Support (Equities, Bonds, OTC Derivatives) SWIFT Messaging (MT300, MT320, MT103, MT202) | Static Data & SSI Management | Settlement Exception & Break Resolution | Corporate Actions Processing Client & Portfolio Onboarding | Stakeholder & Client Liaison | Operational Risk & Compliance | MIS & Regulatory Reporting NAV Analysis & Impact Assessment | Process Documentation & SOP Design | Team Mentoring & Training

TOOLS & PLATFORMS

Bloomberg Terminal | Murex | Finastra | TLM (Transaction Lifecycle Mgmt) | CLS (Continuous Linked Settlement) | FXALL | SWIFT Messaging

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Confirmation Process Specialist | ANZ Support Services India Pvt Ltd — BangaloreAug 2022 – Mar 2026 (Aug 2022–Oct 2024 via BSS Payroll · Nov 2024–Mar 2026 Direct Employee)

Drafted and issued FX trade confirmations across telephony, email, and e-commerce platforms, maintaining high accuracy against internal bookings and full SWIFT MT300/MT320 compliance.

Acted as the last line of defense against settlement failures by managing client affirmations across electronic and manual channels, proactively monitoring and following up to reduce outstanding/unconfirmed trades.

Resolved discrepancies between internal systems and client confirmations by coordinating directly with Front Office, Legal, Operations, and external clients, while maintaining SSI integrity across the client book.

Owned documentation and audit trails for all confirmation activity as primary escalation point for external clients and business lines; contributed to automation initiatives that improved processing efficiency.

Senior Associate – Portfolio Administration | WNS Global Services Pvt Ltd — BangaloreOct 2021 – Jun 2022

Ran daily and monthly cash & position reconciliation across Fixed Income and Derivatives portfolios using TLM, catching discrepancies before they reached clients. Investigated and escalated NAV-impacted breaks within tight SLA windows, protecting fund valuation accuracy.

● Processed and verified weekly postings for expenses, income, withholding tax, FX, and cash adjustments. ● Authored SOP documentation adopted as the team's reference standard for process consistency. Jun 2020 – Sep 2021

● Processed and verified weekly postings for expenses, income, withholding tax, FX, and cash adjustments. ● Authored SOP documentation adopted as the team's reference standard for process consistency. Jun 2020 – Sep 2021

Reconciled cash and positions with custodian banks and prime brokers across Equities, Bonds, OTC, and Derivatives, resolving external discrepancies with minimal back-and-forth.

Ran quality assurance checks on data from internal support functions, catching errors before they propagated downstream.

Built and maintained relationships with brokers, custodians, and fund administrators, measurably cutting average issue- resolution time.

● Owned MIS and analytics reporting cadence (daily, weekly, monthly) with sign-off responsibility on controls.

Senior Operations Executive | BNY Mellon International Operations India Pvt Ltd — PuneNov 2017 – May 2020 (Nov 2017–Jul 2018 via Randstad Staffing · Aug 2018–May 2020 Direct Employee)

Reconciled client and custodian accounts through manual review and automated tooling, resolving discrepancies before EOD cutoffs.

Supported corporate actions, trade operations, and portfolio onboarding as a cross-functional resource. ● Reviewed daily fund processing activities including trade placement, income/expense accounting, and daily NAV calculations.

Mentored junior team members and improved internal documentation practices, raising the team's baseline consistency.

Financial Analyst | Royal Futures Consultants India Pvt Ltd — Pune

Sep 2016 – Oct 2017

Provided financial advisory and trading recommendations across capital, currency, and commodity markets for retail and corporate clients.

Prepared financial reports and conducted technical analysis of market trends and client portfolios. ● Delivered risk management insights and investment positioning guidance to high-net-worth and corporate clients.

EDUCATION

MBA in Finance — Pune University, 2016 B.Com in Financial Markets (BFM) — University of Mumbai, 2013

Confirmation Process Specialist | ANZ Support Services India Pvt Ltd — BangaloreAug 2022 – Mar 2026 (Aug 2022–Oct 2024 via BSS Payroll · Nov 2024–Mar 2026 Direct Employee)
Drafted and issued FX trade confirmations across telephony, email, and e-commerce platforms, maintaining high accuracy against internal bookings and full SWIFT MT300/MT320 compliance.
Acted as the last line of defense against settlement failures by managing client affirmations across electronic and manual channels, proactively monitoring and following up to reduce outstanding/unconfirmed trades.
Resolved discrepancies between internal systems and client confirmations by coordinating directly with Front Office, Legal, Operations, and external clients, while maintaining SSI integrity across the client book.
Owned documentation and audit trails for all confirmation activity as primary escalation point for external clients and business lines; contributed to automation initiatives that improved processing efficiency.
Senior Associate – Portfolio Administration | WNS Global Services Pvt Ltd — BangaloreOct 2021 – Jun 2022
Ran daily and monthly cash & position reconciliation across Fixed Income and Derivatives portfolios using TLM, catching discrepancies before they reached clients. Investigated and escalated NAV-impacted breaks within tight SLA windows, protecting fund valuation accuracy.
● Processed and verified weekly postings for expenses, income, withholding tax, FX, and cash adjustments. ● Authored SOP documentation adopted as the team's reference standard for process consistency. Jun 2020 – Sep 2021
● Processed and verified weekly postings for expenses, income, withholding tax, FX, and cash adjustments. ● Authored SOP documentation adopted as the team's reference standard for process consistency. Jun 2020 – Sep 2021
Reconciled cash and positions with custodian banks and prime brokers across Equities, Bonds, OTC, and Derivatives, resolving external discrepancies with minimal back-and-forth.
Ran quality assurance checks on data from internal support functions, catching errors before they propagated downstream.
Built and maintained relationships with brokers, custodians, and fund administrators, measurably cutting average issue- resolution time.
● Owned MIS and analytics reporting cadence (daily, weekly, monthly) with sign-off responsibility on controls.
Senior Operations Executive | BNY Mellon International Operations India Pvt Ltd — PuneNov 2017 – May 2020 (Nov 2017–Jul 2018 via Randstad Staffing · Aug 2018–May 2020 Direct Employee)
Reconciled client and custodian accounts through manual review and automated tooling, resolving discrepancies before EOD cutoffs.
Supported corporate actions, trade operations, and portfolio onboarding as a cross-functional resource. ● Reviewed daily fund processing activities including trade placement, income/expense accounting, and daily NAV calculations.
Mentored junior team members and improved internal documentation practices, raising the team's baseline consistency.
Financial Analyst | Royal Futures Consultants India Pvt Ltd — Pune
Sep 2016 – Oct 2017
Provided financial advisory and trading recommendations across capital, currency, and commodity markets for retail and corporate clients.
Prepared financial reports and conducted technical analysis of market trends and client portfolios. ● Delivered risk management insights and investment positioning guidance to high-net-worth and corporate clients.
